sections.heading: C — Before You Drive
sections.markdown:
## C — Before You Drive

FACT_ID: sec04-F01 | anchor: A01
Tire crashes are preventable through monthly cold PSI checks against the door sticker and penny-tread tests replacing rubber that bares Lincoln's head [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-F02 | anchor: A01
Drivers sit upright with feet floored, wheel between shoulder and chin, chest 10 inches back, and head restraints meeting the skull above the ears [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-F03 | anchor: A02
Rearview mirrors frame the rear window by day-night setting, while side mirrors lean-set to erase the car's edges and add 12 to 16 degrees per side [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-F04 | anchor: A02
Clear glass means clean windshields, full washer fluid, wiped smoke film, scraped ice, and no hangings, decals, or deep tint [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-F05 | anchor: A02
Kentucky belts every occupant of post-1981 vehicles in proper restraints, since belts beat ejection and hold control [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-F06 | anchor: A03
Staying inside multiplies survival fivefold, and unbelted 55-mph bodies strike the wheel at full speed [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec04-F07 | anchor: A03
Belt law is primary and stoppable, with shoulder straps across chest never under arms and lap belts snug low on hips [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec04-F08 | anchor: A03
Bags supplement belts in moderate-to-severe crashes, firing in a twentieth of a second with a powder puff, so belts stay on always [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec04-F09 | anchor: A03
Seats slide fully back with hands off the wheel's center, nothing on the dash, and children 12 and under belted behind [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec04-F10 | anchor: A04
Rear-facing seats never face live passenger bags, switched off only by factory controls, per the owner's manual [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F11 | anchor: A04
Children 40 inches or shorter ride in federal restraints on pain of a $50 fine plus a $10 brain-injury fee [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F12 | anchor: A04
Under-eight riders between 40 and 57 inches use boosters, and anyone taller than 57 inches skips them [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F13 | anchor: A04
Seats anchor best mid-rear with free fitting help at State Police posts, and leaving under-eight children in grave-risk cars is illegal [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F14 | anchor: A04
Loads count as secure only when nothing can slide, shift, fall, sift, or fly [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F15 | anchor: A05
Cargo gets roped, netted, or tarped without overload, double-checked, pets included, against braking, bumps, and tailgaters' eyes [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F16 | anchor: A05
Assistance tech from blind-spot warnings to auto-braking alerts or steers but never drives, stays banned in part on tests, and wants clean sensors, fresh software, and constant driver focus [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0040]
